games.title: OPENFLIGHT SIM
games.subtitle: Study-Level Browser Flight — Factory Build
games.description: A fixed-step 6-DOF flight simulator built by the Zouroboros Software Factory conveyor. ISA atmosphere with wind, gusts and turbulence, spring-damper gear, three airframes — Skyliner T-76, Voltige X1 and Lumina J-7 — over seeded procedural terrain with a marked runway, approach lighting and a live PAPI. Analog six-pack, glass HUD, four scored missions, and a landing graded on the debrief.

games.title: OPUS 5 FLIGHT SIM
games.subtitle: Six Degrees of Freedom — Zouroboros Field
games.description: A study-level flight simulator in the browser. Rigid-body aerodynamics with published stability derivatives, ISA atmosphere, wind, gusts and turbulence, a live PAPI and a full analog six-pack. Three airframes, five missions, and a landing graded to the foot per minute.

games.title: KINTSPARK: Fracture Run
games.subtitle: Repair the maze. Outsmart the fracture.
games.description: Guide a seam-light repair craft through six authored mineral labyrinths, restore every fracture, and read four distinct geometric sentinels before they close the route.

games.title: SERPENT SHORE RALLY
games.subtitle: Tidebreaker Coast Kart Racing
games.description: Drift across sunlit sand, cave ramps, and a half-submerged shortcut. Outrace five rivals over three laps with tactical items and boost-charged corners.

games.title: Cow Abductors
games.subtitle: 3D UFO Farm Heist
games.description: Pilot a UFO over a night farm, abduct cows with your tractor beam, dodge the angry farmer, and beat the clock. Combos, powerups, and three difficulty tiers.

games.title: VOID BLASTER
games.subtitle: Alien Invasion — Hold the Line
games.description: Four rows of alien invaders descend on your planet. Blast them before they reach you. Destroy the mystery ship for bonus points. Three lives. No mercy.

games.title: JOUST
games.subtitle: Skybound Rivalry
games.description: Flap for height, strike above rival riders, and collect their eggs before they hatch. Survive escalating waves with three lives and no room for a low approach.

games.title: ASTEROID DRIFT
games.subtitle: Vector Space. Survive.
games.description: Your ship drifts through a debris field. Rotate, thrust, and blast. Rocks split. Smaller fragments move faster. Use hyperspace when cornered — if you dare.

games.title: NEON SNAKE
games.subtitle: Bend Time. Chain the Circuit.
games.description: A modern neon snake run with smooth movement, buffered steering, Focus slow-time, rescue shields, five pickup types, timed combos, portals, and escalating speed tiers.
